These P-256 certificates were generated with OpenSSL for the media tests.
The server certificate has one subject alternative name, DNS localhost.
The test client resolves it directly to its own IPv4 loopback listener.
Both certificates are valid from 2000-01-01 to 2100-01-01 00:00 UTC.

The server private key is a public test fixture. The CA private key was
discarded. Only the test client trusts this CA. Never use these fixtures in
an installation or a released binary.
